literal: When staying alone and thinking, my heart was there to devour me.
translation: When I remain all alone and think of him, my own heart is poised to devour me.
modern: நான் தனியாக இருந்து அவரைப் பற்றி நினைக்கும் போது, என் நெஞ்சு என்னை விழுங்குவது போல் வருத்துவதாக இருந்தது.
explanation: In this couplet, the heroine describes the agonizing pain of separation. When she is left entirely alone and begins to contemplate her lover, her own heart does not offer comfort; instead, it turns against her. The word 'tiṉiya' (to eat or devour) vividly illustrates how her inner thoughts and longing feel like a physical force consuming her from within. She expostulates with her heart because its constant dwelling on the beloved acts as a self-destructive torment.
